basis: On August 8, Take-Two issued its initial outlook for fiscal Q2 2024, the three months ending September 30, 2023. It forecast consolidated GAAP total net revenue of $1,260 million to $1,310 million. The high end was 5.99% below the prior-year quarter’s $1,393.5 million and $13.825 million below the $1,323.825 million threshold. The entire range qualified.

coverage.detail: The November 7, 2022 release reported $1,393.5 million in total net revenue for fiscal Q2 2023, ended September 30, 2022. This was Take-Two’s first full quarter including Zynga, so the reported comparator already includes a full quarter of Zynga.
The May 17 preceding-cycle release gave GAAP revenue guidance for fiscal 2024 as a whole and for fiscal Q1 ending June 30. Neither range established September-quarter revenue.
Management’s May 17 prepared remarks identified the outlook periods as the full year and fiscal Q1. They gave no fiscal Q2 GAAP revenue bound.
The May earnings presentation likewise showed guidance tables for FY2024 and Q1 FY2024 on pages 9–12.
The May 18 exhibit announced a tender offer for senior notes. Its $500 million cap applied to debt purchases.
The June 2 exhibit reported early tender results and raised the debt-purchase cap to $650 million.
The companion June 2 exhibit announced tender pricing. Neither June exhibit supplied September-quarter sales guidance.

The August 8 release explicitly called this its initial fiscal Q2 outlook. The three-month table on page 4 placed $1,260 million to $1,310 million on the GAAP total net revenue row. Net Bookings appeared as a separate operational metric.
Management’s August 8 prepared remarks repeated the fiscal Q2 GAAP net revenue forecast of $1.26 billion to $1.31 billion.
Page 9 of the August earnings presentation independently labels the same range as Q2 FY2024 GAAP net revenue guidance.
The September 21 annual-meeting 8-K covered governance and shareholder voting. Its filing index lists no earnings-release exhibit.
The October 11 issuer notice scheduled the November 8 results release and call. It gave no preliminary sales figure or revised range.

The November 8 release confirmed the decline. Its consolidated statements of operations reported September-quarter total net revenue of $1,299.2 million versus $1,393.5 million a year earlier, a 6.77% decline.

publication_date_evidence: Take-Two’s fiscal Q1 earnings release carries the August 8, 2023 New York dateline. The issuer published the initial September-quarter outlook in that release and repeated it on the same day’s earnings call. The issuer-hosted release is https://www.take2games.com/ir/news/take-two-interactive-software-inc-reports-results-fiscal-first-3.
